Dear Maa❤️

Happy 25th Birthday once again ma 🎂❤️, Main agi nin problems na arthamadkothini, kelthini, nin feelings ge value kodthini, kelthini lifelong, Completely change agidhini chinnu naanu, neenu expect madthidha haage

Ee 25th birthday nalli ninge ondu special wish helbeku antha anistu… ninna life alli eshtu beautiful moments barli, ninna face mele smile yavaththu irli. ❤️

Namma journey alli eshto situations bandide, eshto 1000s of memories create aagide… happiness, fights, care, laughter — ella nenapugalu nan heart alli innu special aagiye ive. 🫂

Kelavomme life nam ibbranna swalpa doora maadbahudu… situations change aagbahudu… aadre genuine aagi care maadida manushyaranna heart ashtu easy aagi mareyalla.

Ninna jothe idda aa simple moments, namma conversations, namma laughter… ivella nanage just memories alla ma, nan life na beautiful part. ❤️

Ninna 25th year ninna life ge ondu fresh beginning aagali. Ninge peace sigali, happiness sigali, ninna dreams ella achieve maadu. ✨

yella misunderstandings mattu distance side ge ittu, ibbru matte calm aagi kuthkondu, modlina haage heart open maadi mathadonna ibru somewhere in my heart still wish ide. ❤️🫂

Yake andre, namma story alli innu beautiful pages idhe antha nanna heart innu believe madidhini.

Whatever happens,Kshamisu, ninna happiness nanage always important.

Happy 25th Birthday, Chinnu.Ibru lifelong kushiyagi ottige irrona, kushiyagi life lead madthivi 100% promise, Mathe seroke ibrigu ottige innondhu janma illa ma, plz arthamadko, kushiyagi nodkothini ninna yavaglu promise... ❤️🎂

Keep smiling… always. Innondhu mistake madala yavathu,meet madi mathdonna ibru, ibbru maneyalli kooda opthare , think madbeda idhara bagge, avru namna nodi kushipadthare... 🫂❤️
